body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> PureAir(www.pureair.co.kr) captured the attention of visitors at CES 2008 through its wellbeing products including negative ion generator, memory foam pillow and antifungal deodorant.
Especially the negative ionizer ‘EOS 204/CAR EOS/DESK EOS’ attracted people’s notice, which is ozone-free and generates natural negative ion.

According to the company, an OEM business with a Singapore vendor is now underway and during last year, around 70,000 units of the ionizer have been exported. Recently a foreign buyer appreciated that the ionizer would be a good item for the company to make inroads in Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar as well as Saudi Arabia.

Sun ah Lee, overseas marketing manager of PureAir, answered to the question about the company’s plan to penetrate global market including USA saying, “United States takes great deal of market share in global market. PureAir’s technology level of ozone-free ionizer is high enough to penetrate USA market” and “the products has been considered as a good item to export to global market, featuring advanced design and compact size. Since we exhibited in CES for the first time, we are expecting this show would be a good opportunity for us to be successful in the US market,” he mentioned.
(Picture: Sun ah Lee, overseas marketing manager of PureAir)

Meanwhile, PureAir is now developing a large capacity negative ionizer adopting a sensor that measures pollution level and through this product, the company is looking forward to extending its market share in global market.
